hints.title: Root-to-Node Path Contribution
hints.text: At each node, compute the maximum gain that can be extended upward to its parent by picking at most one child branch.

hints.title: Ignoring Negative Subtree Gains
hints.text: If a subtree contribution is negative, clamp it to zero to avoid reducing the path sum.

hints.title: Bottom-Up Path Peak Calculation
hints.text: For each node, compute left gain max(0, dfs(node.left)) and right gain max(0, dfs(node.right)). The best path turning at this node has sum node.val + left + right; update global maximum with this sum. Return node.val + max(left, right) to parent.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear traversal calculating maximum path sums bottom-up.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every pair of nodes through path finding takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Postorder propagation updates the global maximum while returning single branch gains.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly clamp negative sub-tree returns to 0 and distinguish returning single branch vs turning path.
